description:
Test build, not a release. For stable builds use main/bundles/stable.json.

Image links typed by hand with a capital letter (Https://i.redd.it/...) now count as the post's or comment's own image, so editing the post or comment keeps that image.
Test: edit a post's image link to Https://, add another image in the same edit; edit a comment's image link to Https://.
